desc: A REL area's data is its own (port/coff_section.h): Rogueport's west side (gor_01) runs its map event and the area's battle 0 starts and plays a turn. Built with a clang that drops '#pragma clang section' names for COFF (VS 2022's clang 18) and no fallback, gor's scripts and unit data were zero-filled: a crash entering the map (make_jump_table ran off the script) or spawning the battle's units (BattleAlloc NULL at battle_unit.c:186)
